title: Global Top Three AI Platforms Suffer Mass Outage: ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Suddenly Experience Large-Scale Downtime, All Now Fully Recovered

content_html:
On September 3rd local time, the global artificial intelligence industry experienced a rare collective failure. Major AI large models, including ChatGPT from OpenAI, Grok from SpaceX AI, and Claude from Anthropic, almost simultaneously began to experience large-scale outages, affecting many users' daily usage and workflows temporarily.

This sudden failure affected the top AI large model platforms that are currently receiving the most attention worldwide, drawing high levels of attention from the industry and users. After emergency investigation and repair by the relevant technical teams, the failures on these platforms have been successfully resolved.

After the service was restored, the official teams of ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok promptly updated their service status pages to inform users, clearly stating that the technical issues had been completely resolved, and all core functions and API calls were now operating normally.
